preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Contract must have accumulated BNB from token fees in its balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable automatic fee processing, then manually trigger swapAndLiquify() with a large contract token balance. This will cause the contract to swap tokens for BNB and transfer a significant portion (marketingBNBToDonate) to the hardcoded marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110). If the attacker controls the marketing address, they receive the BNB. Alternatively, the owner can change the marketing address to their own address first using a setter function if available, or exploit other owner-only functions to drain funds.
